(https://github.com/alphacep/vosk-api), also Apache License 2.0.
Full license text: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

Modification (Capri): in the embedded worker, Emscripten's createNamedFunction returns a plain
wrapper instead of building a named one with `new Function` (see the header of vosk.js).

The Portuguese model in assets/vosk/model-pt.tar.gz is vosk-model-small-pt-0.3
(https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models), Apache License 2.0, repacked from .zip to .tar.gz.
